title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00064 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
11:45 - 16:30: Prepared for skidding from well f-1c to well f-15d deck, cantilever, moonpool. Performed TBT prior to skidding. Carried out last preparations prior to skid. Removed stairs to cantilever. Skidded cantilever.
16:30 - 17:30: Stopped skidding due to burst hose on skid cylinder. Changed same.
17:30 - 18:30: Continued skidding cantilever onto f-15d well
18:30 - 19:00: Re-installed stairs on cantilever
19:00 - 19:45: Performed daily maintenance on the drill floor. Respooled rig floor tugger. Started working on changing out slew motor on aft PRS
19:45 - 20:00: Prejob meeting for stripping annular BOP for inspection. Prejob meeting for rigging up at XT deck. Worked on changing out slew motor on aft PRS
20:00 - 21:30: Continued working on annular BOP and rigging up bleed off manifold on XT deck. Worked on changing out slew motor on aft PRS
21:30 - 00:00: Removed cap and annular element, cleaned surface and replaced adaptor ring. Worked on changing out slew motor on aft PRS
